vocalProtection.wetPolicy: Original hook plate only until source79.755; closed before the following dry-word pickup at79.76. No added reverb. Entry/exit are in the measured dry quiet valleys, not on cue-estimated body.

levels.policy: Single static program gain; loudnorm used only to measure. No compression, limiting, dynamic loudnorm, pitch/time edits or vocal-envelope fading added.
levels.tradeoff: Preserve vocal dynamics and a continuous same-song beat; peak ceiling takes priority over forcing exactly-14LUFS.

effects.reason: No game SFX rights/recording assumptions; no fixed150BPM tick/sweep layer.

verificationScope.finalVideoAndAac: Root will export/verify the final MP4 separately.
